forum.title: handling of LDMA_TX bit in HAL_SPI_Transmit_DMA
forum.best_answer_content:
Ahh, the L4. I've corrected the OP to refer to STM32L4, not F4, in the text.

Looks like a bug to me.
forum.content_text:
According to Page 1354 of rm0394, setting LDMA\_TX bit must occur only when SPE=0.

However, from my reading of the function HAL\_SPI\_Transmit\_DMA, this bit may be set or cleared when the DataSize <= 8bit and MemDataAlignment == HALFWORD, even if SPE=1.

This looks like a bug.

Am I correct?

STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32F4 STM32L4, version 1.28.3
